responsibility: This file implements the alists ADDRESS container as a chunked linked list of fixed-size element arrays, providing append, indexed lookup, search, duplicate suppression, deletion, traversal, and cloning. Within mc it serves as a lightweight general-purpose list structure for housekeeping tasks such as queues of nodes or temporary filenames, distinct from the indexed array services in Indexing and the symbol trees in symbolKey.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the alists stem, defining alist as linked fixed-size chunks and implementing traversal and mutation; the same-named .def file only declares those operations as an abstract interface.
